name: portable-planner
description: Explore rough ideas, then turn them into approved durable plans, visual routes, and build-ready execution tickets.

interface.shortDescription: Explore or plan any idea without walls of text.
interface.longDescription: Can optionally scan current public repositories at the start of a rough software idea, then uses brief recommendation-first planning, explicit reversible-decision delegation, bounded decision trials, durable visual plans, and session-sized execution tickets that begin through the normal harness workflow after approval.
defaultPrompt: Explore what is possible for this rough software idea.
